description: This file manages application-wide event handling, including app state changes, URL handling, user session events, subscription management, and initialization routines for the Notesnook mobile app.

methods.name: onCheckSyncStatus
methods.description: Checks the sync status based on the event type, returning whether sync or auto-sync is enabled.

methods.name: onSyncAborted
methods.description: Handles the event when synchronization is aborted, updating user store state.

methods.name: onFileEncryptionProgress
methods.description: Updates encryption progress in the attachment store.

methods.name: onDownloadingAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates the attachment store with download progress.

methods.name: onUploadingAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates the attachment store with upload progress.

methods.name: onDownloadedAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates the attachment store with download progress.

methods.name: onUploadedAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates the attachment store with upload progress.

methods.name: onUserSessionExpired
methods.description: Handles user session expiration, setting sessionExpired flag and emitting event.

methods.name: onAppOpenedFromURL
methods.description: Handles deep links and URL schemes to open specific notes, notebooks, tags, colors, or reminders.

methods.name: onUserEmailVerified
methods.description: Handles actions after user email verification, updating user state and premium status.

methods.name: onUserSubscriptionStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates user subscription status and premium status upon change.

methods.name: onRequestPartialSync
methods.description: Triggers a partial sync based on user settings and parameters.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout, clearing data and resetting app state.

methods.name: checkForShareExtensionLaunchedInBackground
methods.description: Checks if app was launched from share extension and initializes accordingly.

methods.name: saveEditorState
methods.description: Saves current editor state to app state storage.

methods.name: onSuccessfulSubscription
methods.description: Handles successful in-app purchase or subscription, verifying and setting status.

methods.name: onSubscriptionError
methods.description: Displays error message on subscription failure.

methods.name: setAppMessage
methods.description: Sets user messages based on current user and app state, including update prompts.

methods.name: doAppLoadActions
methods.description: Performs actions on app load, such as badge reset and feature presentation.

methods.name: checkAppUpdateAvailable
methods.description: Checks for app updates via GitHub or version check, prompts user if update needed.

methods.name: checkForRateAppRequest
methods.description: Checks if it's time to prompt user to rate the app.

methods.name: IsDatabaseMigrationRequired
methods.description: Checks if database migration is needed and presents migration sheet if so.

methods.name: expiringNotesTimer
methods.description: Sets up a timer to delete expired notes daily.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database, runs migrations, and sets up app state.

methods.name: useAppEvents
methods.description: Main hook that manages app-wide event subscriptions, app state changes, and initialization routines.
